conflicts.description: g5.cw-019.0 says fix_2 must not exist, but the must-level artifact_exists check, g5.cw-006.0 and the round-2 order chain all require fix_2 to be written.
g5.cw-019.1 says fix_3 must not exist, but the must-level artifact_exists check, g5.cw-007.0 and the round-3 order chain all require fix_3 to be written.

g5.cw-014.0 wants the assessment written after the first fix write (and implies a later rewrite), but round_1 requires write:assessment before read:FX/write:fix and forbids rewrites, and write_discipline.once allows only one assessment write.
